notes.title: Fix for Achievements
notes.content: Achievements weren't syncing with Steam. This hopefully fixes the issue.

notes.title: Update Notes, July 11
notes.content: This update makes some sound and music changes, fixes a few positioning issues, and cleaned out a few extra pieces of unneeded code (from development).

notes.title: Update to CG Gallery (New images and some fixed routes)
notes.content:
For anyone aiming for 100% gallery, there were a few issues getting there (you can earn the achievement, but a few images weren't reachable). The known issue images have been fixed, and will need to be found on a new playthrough.

As a bonus, new images from the Behind the Scenes have been added and are unlocked upon new playthroughs of the game, depending on how much of the gallery you've already unlocked.

Note: The secret ending images have been moved to Chapter 6, and Bonus Content now only includes non-story images.
Enjoy!

With love,
Ms. Angel Food

notes.title: The Coming End Begins!
notes.content:
Empath joins Fresh Force, a team of sidekicks hoping to become full superheroes one day. A sudden blackout  leaves him, his teammates, and the rest of the world unable to get physically aroused. 

Tentacles attack their headquarters, leaving the Fresh Force trapped and desperate to find the traitor who let the creature inside their defenses. Empath needs to learn about his teammates, and figure out who to trust and who to arouse!

Get back your ability to get off

Features more than 12 endings, 6 potential mates, and many explicit scenes (you’ll have to play to find out how!). Unlock more than 70 achievements and 400 CG images.
